metadata.summary: The customer attempted to order an Avocado BLT Sandwich, which is not on the menu, and the conversation was cut short.

messages.text: Hello Jutin Welcome to manhattan bagel It is great to see you again What would you like to order?
Looking to order a big, avocado BLT sandwich.
For the Garden Avocado Egg White Sandwich, you'll need to pick just one bagel for your sandwich. We have Plain, Everything,
No. I said avocado BLD sandwich.
I don't see Avocado BLT Sandwich on our menu. However, we do have some great options like the Big City BLT,
